title: Activation Steering with Jungian Cognitive Functions
abstract: arXiv:2607.20803v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Controlling combinations of personality-related tendencies is important for adapting large language models to diverse interaction needs. But successful single-trait steering does not establish how to construct interventions for joint targets, or whether existing trait directions adequately represent them. We introduce a target-first framework that directly extracts steering directions from joint personality targets and then examines their decomposition into individual directions. To support this framework, we construct NarrationDB, linking character self-narrations to automatically evaluated joint scores across eight Jungian-inspired functions, a correspondence not directly available in existing Big Five- or MBTI-oriented resources. translated_title: 基于荣格认知功能的激活引导
translated_abstract: 控制人格相关倾向的组合对于使大型语言模型适应多样化的交互需求非常重要。但成功的单特质引导并不能说明如何为联合目标构建干预，也无法确定现有的特质方向是否能够充分表示它们。我们引入了一个以目标为先的框架，直接从联合人格目标中提取引导方向，然后考察其向个体方向的分解。为支持这一框架，我们构建了NarrationDB，将角色自我叙述与八个荣格启发式功能的自动评估联合分数相关联，这种对应关系在现有的面向大五人格或MBTI的资源中无法直接获得。在三个模型上的实验证明了八个功能的问卷分数可控性，以及所测试的双功能目标中的协调变化。直接提取的联合方向…
tldr: 该论文提出了一个以目标为先的框架，直接从联合人格目标中提取激活引导方向，并构建了NarrationDB数据集，将角色自我叙述与八个荣格认知功能的自动评估联合评分相关联，从而实现了对大语言模型多个人格特质的联合可控性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a target-first framework that directly extracts steering directions from joint personality targets, supported by NarrationDB—a dataset linking character self-narrations to automatically evaluated joint scores across eight Jungian-inspired cognitive functions—enabling joint multi-trait personality control of large language models.
